when I was about twenty (68 now) (M) I happened to get to know an artist. Among other things, he found an old fashioned room screen and painted a picture on it in the style of ancient Chinese painters, of running horses. Wonderful, powerful piece. I'm not a possessions person, usually, but I wanted that so bad...couldn't afford it. He wanted $500, had spent probably 200 hours on it; I couldn't make that. Still think about it often. Then there was the time I had a chance to buy a vibraphone. Again, $500. Again, couldn't make it. Again, still think of it as 'the deal that got away'.
